notes: High-utility beginner family vocabulary. Use 夫 when referring neutrally to your own husband.
naturalUsageNotes: A neutral standard way to refer to your own husband. For another person's husband, ご主人 is usually more appropriate.

exampleSentence: ご主人は日本語を話しますか。
notes: High-utility beginner family vocabulary. Polite term for another person's husband.
naturalUsageNotes: A polite way to refer to another person's husband. It is not usually the neutral choice for referring to your own husband.
